name: Houinbou Ryouken
source:
Bodhidharma Kanis is an infamous blind assassin who used his pet dog Helmut not only a guide dog, but also as a weapon in his jobs. Despite his blindness, Kanis was feared for his skills as an assassin, with the ringing of the unique bells being said to be the last things his victims would hear.

[From [url=http://aceattorney.wikia.com/wiki/Ry%C5%8Dken_H%C5%8Dinb%C5%8D]Ace Attorney Wiki[/url]]
